Lessons.Title: Ten Times As Much
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will write equations to represent the relationship between the value of digits in multi-digit numbers.
In the previous lesson, you wrote multi-digit numbers in expanded form to highlight the value of each digit. You also described the “ten times” relationship between the value of a digit in one place and the value of the same digit in the place to its right. In this lesson, you use multiplication and division equations to represent this relationship. - Engagement
Core relationship: A place to the left is ten times as much. Moving the same digit one place to the left multiplies its value by ten.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up: Number Talk: Related Numbers (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Alike but Not the Same	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  More and More Money	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Same Digit, Different Place	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many times as large is 9,000 as 900?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): What number is ten times 7,000?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
